_file_status: FIXTURE — dry-run pipeline proof only, reviewed for this lane's own dry-run evidence. NOT sourced from a real ship's MRV filing and NOT to be applied to production as-is. A real, reviewed rows-file needs primary-sourced per-ship data — see the companion worklist: scripts/_worklists/statutory-fueleu-annex-iv-2026-09-05.BROWSER-WORKLIST.md, which names the exact fetches a browser-capable lane needs to run to replace this file's rows with real ones.

_schema.shipKey: string — the ship's IMO number (or another stable per-ship key). This lane's fixture row uses an obviously-synthetic key so it can never be mistaken for a real vessel.
_schema.targetYear: integer — must be a key of write-statutory.mjs's SUPPORTED_TARGET_YEARS. Only 2025 is implemented today (Regulation (EU) 2023/1805 Art. 4(2), verified live against EUR-Lex CELEX:32023R1805 by lane DAG-AUTHOR, 2026-09-04 — see write-statutory.mjs's own file header). Every other target year is refused by name, never guessed.
_schema.obligationSeed: optional string, defaults to write-statutory.mjs's DEFAULT_OBLIGATION_SEED ('fueleu-maritime-annex-iv-penalty')
_schema.ghgIntensityActual: StatutoryInput {value: number (gCO2eq/MJ), unit: string, citation: string, asOf: {eventDate: 'YYYY-MM-DD'}, derivation: Contractable ('observed'|'transacted_index'|'assessed'|'calculated'), originClass: string, lifecycle: string, admissibility: string, baseConfidence: number} — the ship-year's actual well-to-wake GHG intensity of energy used on board, per Regulation (EU) 2023/1805 Art. 4/Annex I methodology.
_schema.energyUsedMJ: StatutoryInput, same shape, unit 'MJ' — total energy used on board for the ship-year (Annex I).
_schema.consecutiveDeficitYears: StatutoryInput, same shape, unit 'count' — the ship's consecutive-year compliance-deficit count (Art. 20's escalating penalty multiplier input).
